request: Find all completed orders along with customer names and order dates.

reasoning.dependency_order: Join orders with customers table on customer_id

response.sql: SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer_name, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'completed';
response.explanation: Joins orders and customers on customer_id to return completed orders.

request: What are the top 3 best-selling products by total quantity sold?

reasoning.dependency_order: Join products and order_items, aggregate sum of quantity grouped by product

response.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 3;
response.explanation: Aggregates total quantity sold per product and limits to top 3.
